title: I WILL SING I WILL SING

lines.text: I will sing, I will sing a song unto the Lord. (3)
Allelu, alleluia, glory to the Lord. (3)
We will come, we will come as one before the Lord. (3)
If the Son, if the Son shall make you free, (3)
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy, (3)
Every knee shall bow and every tongue confess, (3)
In His name, in His name we have the victory, (3)
